rule.alternative: one same-box different-pose then one cross-box; absent class leaves gap, no fill
rule.decision: parent real Jev job order then ascending decision; earliest committed multi-choice with complete verified input
rule.dedup: SHA256 of pick_item_id, pose and oriented_size_mm; exclude original and duplicate exact actions

rule.stop: natural stop; technical error stops remaining branches; no reselection or replacement
